kept.excerpt: Turning to Putin's international contacts, Peskov confirmed that the Russian president plans to attend the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) summit in Bishkek on Aug. 31-Sept. 1, but said it was too early to provide details of potential bilateral meetings on the sidelines.
kept.relevance: This provides a Kremlin-confirmed travel opportunity overlapping the deadline while establishing that bilateral meeting details were still unavailable.

kept.excerpt: Kyrgyzstan is completing preparations for a series of international events scheduled to take place in Bishkek from August 30 to September 1. During this period, the capital will host the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation summit, meetings in the “SCO+” format and the opening ceremony of the VI World Nomad Games. The final list of heads of state and their spouses attending the events is expected to be announced once the schedules of the foreign delegations have been fully coordinated.
kept.relevance: The preview identifies possible in-person diplomatic opportunities around the deadline and explicitly preserves uncertainty about attendance.

search_notes: Frozen cutoff: 2026-08-21. Included only sources with explicit publication dates on or before that date; excluded later reporting, undated material, prediction-market pages, odds, and prices. Publication dates and excerpts were verified through web_search source text. web_fetch failed because multiple fetch providers were registered; the requested agent-reach web-read fallback returned RATE_LIMITED, so full-page retrieval could not be completed. The January Anadolu article was updated January 31, also before the cutoff. Earlier documented meetings are included as pre-cutoff factual evidence without issuing a market resolution; the supplied rules do not specify a starting date for eligible meetings. No post-cutoff meeting announcements or developments are included.
